backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining data types (UserProfile, Hospital, BloodDonor, Volunteer, SOSEvent, EmergencyAlert, EmergencyContact) and CRUD endpoints for each, with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and blob storage via MixinStorage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs and titles (Overpass API hospital fetching, leaflet-routing-machine directions, and others) to their implementing files, component dependencies, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for what each page, hook, component, and utility does.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme tokens (colors, radius, chart palette, sidebar) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app that loads Leaflet CSS/JS from CDN and mounts the React root; sets the page title to 'CrisisConnect – Emergency Response'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all application routes (dashboard, hospitals, blood-donors, volunteers, map, emergency-contacts) wrapped under an authenticated AppLayout, plus a standalone login route.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertCrea: Collapsible form component for posting emergency alerts, allowing users to select an alert type, enter a description and location, and submit via the usePostEmergencyAlert mutation with toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertFeed: Displays a feed of emergency alerts fetched via a query hook, rendering each alert with type-specific colors, time-ago formatting, and location info, with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/UserProfile: Modal form for new users to enter their name, city, and contact number, saving the profile via a mutation hook and calling an onComplete callback on success.
Card component displaying a blood donor's name, blood type (color-coded), city, contact link, and proof submission status.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/ChatbotB: Floating action button that toggles the FirstAidChatbot panel open or closed, with a visual indicator badge.
frontend/src/components/chatbot/FirstAid: Chat UI for a first-aid decision-tree bot, rendering message bubbles with optional step-by-step guidance cards, warning lists, and emergency category selection buttons.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable stat display card with an icon, numeric value, label, and color theme (red/amber/blue/green), supporting a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/hospitals/Hospit: Card component showing a hospital's name, address, available bed count (color-coded by availability), contact link, and optional distance indicator.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component providing the sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, SOS button, user profile setup modal trigger, chatbot button, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/sos/SOSButton.ts: Renders a pulsing red SOS button that opens the SOSModal when clicked.
frontend/src/components/sos/SOSModal.tsx: Modal that handles the full SOS flow: geolocation, a 5-second countdown, sending the alert via the backend, and displaying emergency contact info.
frontend/src/components/volunteer/Volunt: Displays a compact card for a volunteer showing their name, city, active status, and color-coded skill badges.
Dialog modal showing full volunteer details including name, city, status, skills, and submitted proof credential.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirstAidBot.ts: Hook managing a first-aid chatbot's message state, supporting keyword search, category selection, and conversation reset using a local decision tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Hook that wraps the browser Geolocation API to request the user's current position, returning position, loading, and error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposed through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, hospitals, blood donors, volunteers, SOS events, emergency alerts, and emergency contacts, with toast notifications on success/error.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind, imports fonts, defines an emergency dark theme via CSS custom properties, and adds utility classes and animations (glow effects, SOS pulse, Leaflet dark theme overrides).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/BloodDonorPage.tsx: Page for browsing and registering blood donors, with blood-type filtering, search, file-based blood type detection from uploaded proof documents, and a manual selector fallback for image files.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying live stats (hospitals, beds, donors, volunteers), a live emergency alert feed with auto-refresh, an alert creation form, and quick-access navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/EmergencyContactsPage: Page for authenticated users to manage personal emergency contacts (add/remove), with form validation and a login gate for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/HospitalFinderPage.ts: A page that fetches nearby hospitals from both a backend API and OpenStreetMap's Overpass API, merges and deduplicates results, and displays them as a filterable/searchable list with distance, contact, and emergency info.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: The login page for CrisisConnect that authenticates users via Internet Identity, redirects authenticated users to the dashboard, and showcases platform features like hospital finder, blood donors, and first aid AI.
frontend/src/pages/ResourceMapPage.tsx: An interactive Leaflet map page that loads hospital data from the backend and Overpass API, plots markers, and supports turn-by-turn routing to a selected hospital using leaflet-routing-machine.
frontend/src/pages/VolunteerPage.tsx: A page for browsing, searching, and registering emergency volunteers, displaying skill badges and active status, with a registration form and a detail modal for each volunteer.
frontend/src/utils/bloodTypeDetection.ts: Exports a utility function that detects ABO/Rh blood types from free text using priority-ordered regex patterns, testing AB types before A/B to avoid false positives.
Defines a static decision tree of first aid guidance (steps, warnings, urgency) for emergency categories like CPR, choking, bleeding, and burns, along with keyword mappings for category detection.
frontend/src/utils/haversine.ts: Exports a haversine formula function to calculate the great-circle distance in kilometers between two lat/lng coordinates, plus a helper to format the distance as meters or kilometers.
frontend/src/utils/overpass.ts: Provides utilities for querying the Overpass API to find nearby hospitals, including functions to build queries, fetch results, parse address/phone/hours tags, check emergency status, and calculate haversine distance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts (Inter, Space Grotesk), an extended color palette including emergency/crisis colors and sidebar tokens, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document for CrisisConnect describing the app's architecture (React/Tailwind, Node.js/Firebase, Google Maps, OpenAI), existing features, and a list of known bugs to fix including hospital map filtering, volunteer registration, and blood type detection issues.
